name: Hungry Hearts Ramen: Soulful Bowl
summary:
Manage a plucky, upcoming ramen shop run by a sweet elderly couple in this narrative-driven store management sim. Get to know the clientele while you help Granny and Gramps build their humble shop into a local institution!

Serve up piping hot ramen, fried rice, gyoza, and shumai to happy customers.
Are they still hungry? There's always chili shrimp, liver and leeks, or happosai!
Are they bottomless pits?! Then hit 'em with some kanitama, zasai, or bang bang chicken!
Gramps's repertoire starts off limited but his pantry will expand the more he cooks, giving him plenty of options to feed all the hungry folks that darken his door!

And what a cast of characters awaits! You'll meet all manner of eccentrics and colorful personalities, just waiting to open up to you over a nice, hot meal. Keep them fed and keep them talking, and you'll pull the curtain back on a variety of tales in this tiny community.

The only way to the heart of this story is through its stomach, so get cooking!

The game is playable from start to finish for free, so don't hesitate to walk on through that door and get to know Granny and Gramps in the latest installment of the acclaimed Hungry Hearts series!

We're happy to have you at our table, whether you're a new or returning fan!
